scope: Written infinite-degree trace-norm and semigroup proofs for N>1, and all-time rational quotient/localization proofs with q-stable full lattices. Finite Smith controls use the declared Lipschitz lattice only, not an identification with the entire marked CM/E8 lattice. 67 independent-implementation operator controls, 332 relative-return controls, ten regression tests, normal/-OO byte agreement.
